svg.title: FG-E4: Two meanings of absolute value
svg.desc: The dashed line is f(x)=x−1. Bar placement determines which quantity becomes nonnegative. Static design sketch showing two selected states. Read the learning plan for the full interaction.
svg.text: FG-E4 / Two meanings of absolute value
ANNOTATED DESIGN SKETCH · selected states, not a production screen
Follow a negative output as it folds up.
At x=−2, the new output is 3.
At x=−2, the new output is 1.
The dashed line is f(x)=x−1. Bar placement determines which quantity becomes nonnegative.
